issue_request: FHIR-18075 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core terminology issue raised against STU3. It reported that the Value Set References table incorrectly listed ValueSet.compose.import and, in a follow-up comment, clarified that the row should say ValueSet.compose.include.valueSet.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to GH#26ab1ccb3a. Git commit 26ab1ccb3adecdf74596c6ce3cf837eca048a2a3 changed source/terminologies.html from ValueSet.compose.import to ValueSet.compose.include.valueSet on 2018-10-17, and current blame for the row still points to that commit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps resourceType to the terminologies page and lists valueset as an active resource, so source/terminologies.html and source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml are build-scope inputs. The current ValueSet definition contains ValueSet.compose.include.valueSet, current source/ contains no ValueSet.compose.import references, and remaining compose.import hits are limited to tools/history/release2 historical artifacts. A 2016 Zulip committers thread confirms the STU3 rename from ValueSet.compose.import to ValueSet.compose.include.valueSet; Confluence searches found no issue-specific conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current terminology table and ValueSet definition already satisfy the Jira request.
